# Anthony Humphreys

Anthony Humphreys is a senior developer building applied AI tools, mobile platforms, AWS-backed services, and research software.

## Core Skills

- Software delivery from discovery through implementation, release, and iteration.
- Technical leadership: turning ambiguous goals into practical technical options.
- AWS architecture judgement, supported by AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional.
- Applied AI systems for real workflows, including employability tooling and job matching.
- Mobile platforms, especially React Native and Expo-based student-facing services.
- Research translation: turning academic, public science, sustainability, and data projects into usable web software.
- Cloud delivery, service design, stakeholder collaboration, and maintainable engineering practices.
- Delivery maturity across implementation, observability, handover, operations, and service ownership.

## Selected Work

- iLancaster: student-facing mobile platform work including Expo migration, check-in flows, digital passes, safety tooling, performance, and support visibility.
- LUCA: careers AI assistant for CV review, cover letter feedback, interview practice, job description analysis, and progress support.
- IceHunter front-end: research interface for iceberg detection outputs using map-based satellite and AI data.
- Sustainable packaging tool: web tooling for eCommerce packaging decisions across cost, compliance, and environmental impact.
- AuroraWatch UK refresh: public science platform modernisation for aurora data and alerts.
- Prob_AI research hub: public research site using Next.js, Mantine UI, AWS, integrations, and admin workflows.
- Lexio, GMprentice, and JobMatch AI: small software experiments and SaaS offerings.

## Technical Leadership

Anthony works on the messy bit between the idea and the running system: clarifying goals, identifying risky assumptions, shaping architecture, and keeping delivery plans connected to the teams who will operate and change the system afterwards.

Architecture interests include serverless and cloud-native systems, event-driven design, identity and permissions, data flow, deployment, observability, reliability, failure modes, cost control, and operational support.
